name: Jedi transportation ship
description: The Jedi transportation ship was a type of shuttle used by the Jedi Order. In the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in 232 BBY, Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi and Jedi Master Arkoff used a Jedi transportation ship to help transport refugees to the Outer Rim planet Banchii. Later, Tora-Asi and the younglings Nima Allets and Viv'Nia Nia'Viv used the ship to travel to and from the Starlight Beacon space station.
